_note: Candidate decision packages to compare against nodecision. Pick one in the Run form ('decisions'). The winner goes into decisions.json word for word, then lock it on the dashboard. Messages are DRAFTS for the team to review: they promise only what the actions deliver (red line: no false or misleading statement). single_<action>_w<week>: one action in one week, to compare actions and timing one at a time.

actions.action: Backup ground handling contract at both bases for the strike days
Extra airport and call-center staff for 2 weeks
Free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window

A_operations.message: Workers at our ground handling contractor plan a 48-hour strike in Orlando and Philadelphia on December 22-23. We have hired backup ground crews at both airports and added airport and call-center staff. If you fly with us between December 14 and 27, you can change or cancel your booking free of charge in the app. We will text you if your flight changes.
A_operations.why:
Cut strike-day cancellations at the source (backup crews).
Keep rebooking within 24h with more staff on the phones.
Let worried travelers move dates before the strike, free.

actions.action: Rebooking deal with a partner airline for 2 disrupted weeks
Hotel rooms held for stranded passengers, whatever the cause

A_operations.message: If your Kestrel flight is canceled or badly delayed during the strike, we will rebook you on Kestrel or a partner airline, and we are holding hotel rooms for anyone stranded overnight, whatever the cause. You can always choose a refund instead if your flight is canceled or significantly delayed. Check the app for your options.
A_operations.why:
Get stranded holiday travelers moving within 24h.
Remove the worst outcome: a night in the airport.
State refund rights plainly; they are not a favor.

D_engine_info.message: Kestrel update: The FAA and our engine maker have asked all airlines to inspect a part on one engine type as a precaution. Some of our aircraft use this engine. No Kestrel aircraft has had a problem with this part. Inspections start this week and may take some aircraft out of service for a short time. If a check affects your flight, we will text you with your options at least 24 hours ahead. Safety comes first, always. Questions? Reply HELP or open the app.
D_engine_info.why:
Passengers saw the TikTok video before they heard from us.
Say what is known and what is not; promise only notice, not outcomes.
Cheapest action on the menu so the message can go out.

F_S2_free7_hotel8.message: Kestrel Air: a 48-hour ground handling strike is planned at Orlando and Philadelphia on Dec 22-23, and flights on those days may be late or canceled. The union says the strike may be extended. If you can travel on another day, move your flight now for free in the app; days before Dec 22 are the safest. If you keep your flight and it is canceled, we will rebook you on the next Kestrel flight with a free seat, or refund you in full if you prefer. All our aircraft are back in service after the engine inspections.
F_S2_free7_hotel8.why:
Own seats in week 8 are 97% booked, so moving people off the strike days early is the cheapest protection.
The strike-day response follows in week 8, once we know whether the strike is extended.
An honest early warning is what passengers remember.

F_S2_free7_hotel8.message: Kestrel Air: the ground handling strike at Orlando and Philadelphia is on December 22-23, and flights on those days may be late or canceled. If your flight is canceled or delayed over 3 hours, we will rebook you on the next Kestrel flight with a free seat, or refund you in full. If you are stranded overnight for any reason, a hotel room is held for you at no cost; show your boarding pass at the Kestrel desk.

Families and vacationers are 88% of week-8 passengers; being stranded without a bed is what they remember.
Next free Kestrel seats can be days away in a 97%-booked week.
A hotel promise is cheap and easy to keep.

A leased aircraft replaces one of the three.
Fewer cancellations is what passengers remember.
